data.message: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆನ್‌ಬೋರ್ಡಿಂಗ್ 'ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ' ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತಿದೆ. ಖಾತೆ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಅಥವಾ IFSC ತಪ್ಪಾಗಿದೆ, ಅಥವಾ ಖಾತೆ ಸಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ₹1 ಪರೀಕ್ಷಾ ಜಮೆ ವಿಫಲವಾಗಿದೆ. ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಖಾತೆ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಮತ್ತು IFSC ಅನ್ನು ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಮತ್ತೆ ನಮೂದಿಸಿ, ಮತ್ತು ಖಾತೆ ಸಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿದೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಜಮೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಬಲ್ಲದು ಎಂದು ಖಚಿತಪಡಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ. ನಂತರ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆನ್‌ಬೋರ್ಡಿಂಗ್ ಖಾತೆಗೆ ಸೈನ್ ಇನ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿ. ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.

Catalog (code | reviewer reason | plain meaning):
R01 | PAN name does not match business name | The name on the PAN card is different from the business name entered.
R02 | GST certificate invalid or mismatched | GSTIN is wrong, inactive, or belongs to a different legal name or address.
R03 | Bank account name mismatch | The bank account holder name differs from the business or PAN name.
R04 | Bank verification failed | Account number or IFSC is wrong, or the account is inactive, so the Re 1 test credit failed.
R05 | Document unreadable | The uploaded image or PDF is blurred, cropped, or password-protected.
R06 | Website missing mandatory policy pages | Website or app lacks Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy, Refund/Cancellation Policy or Contact details.
R07 | Website not live | Website is down, under construction, or needs a login to view products and prices.
R08 | Address proof missing or outdated | No address proof, or the proof is older than 3 months or shows a different address.
R09 | Signatory details incomplete | Authorised signatory or director ID is missing, or the details don't match the application.
R10 | Restricted business category | The business sells products or services we cannot support (for example gambling or prohibited goods).
R11 | Declared category differs from website | The business category selected differs from what the website actually sells.
R12 | Compliance / sanctions screening hit | The application matched a negative or sanctions list during screening.
R13 | Abandoned application | No rejection. The applicant started the application but stopped without finishing.

Reviewer note:
<<<
Signatory ka ID proof upload nahi hua
>>>
